transaction_adoption.observed_contract: The installed 0.0.48 PsycopgHost.adopt_transaction defaults to isolation=read_committed and compares the caller transaction profile against the requested (isolation, access_mode), returning invalid_transaction on mismatch.

transaction_adoption.recovery_profile: Begin the read-only reconciliation transaction explicitly with BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED, READ ONLY, apply the unchanged 2000 ms SET LOCAL statement_timeout, and adopt with access_mode="read_only". No isolation change or timeout increase is needed.

contract_findings.accepted_source_access: The public accepted_document person entrypoint checks caller membership in configured module_access reader/writer roles and checks EXECUTE on accepted_document. The installer revokes PUBLIC access; configure_module_access_in_transaction grants the public source-read function to the configured reader and writer roles after catalog acceptance.
contract_findings.complete_catalog_view_access_mode: The public catalog_view_basis function returns NULL when transaction_read_only=on. Complete catalog_view_in_transaction therefore uses a READ COMMITTED READ WRITE transaction while invoking only the public catalog_view method; no catalog mutation or direct table read is performed.
